title: Court supply by location v1
description: Latest PBPlus/source venue observations grouped by explicit address-derived named-place key. Source addresses are not independently verified geography. Unresolved venues are reported separately as quality rows. Coverage is source-specific, not national completeness. No capacity or demand inference.

venue_count.description: Distinct latest logical venues with a resolved source-address place.

known_court_count.description: Sum of explicitly known number_of_courts values; null when none are known. Missing counts never become zero or one.
